This lesson skips the machines and covers how to band together: GTNHLib ships the §3§n/gtnhteam§r command — type it to open the team GUI, where you can create a team, invite teammates, or accept an invitation to join one.

A team is more than a name tag: the GTIT wallet supports a §2TEAM shared-wallet§r mode — once enabled, the team's funds are pooled; your teammate's money is everybody's money, and saving up for big-ticket items no longer turns into debt collecting.

Form the party first, then start the work — splits and dividends both go smoother.

§8§oA lone wolf is romance; a team is productivity.§r
